**Pull requests are not accepted on this repository.**

Unrestor is a personal project: open source, but not open for contributions.
Outside pull requests are rejected without review, however good they are.

- Want a change? Fork the project (Apache-2.0) and make it yours.
- Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue instead. Issues are welcome, with
  no guarantee they will be answered or fixed.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
